items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: George was playing with, he split with Buddy Petit after, after Buddy Petit split his band up. And Morris, Morris Fletcher was playing with Buddy Petit. And after, he split up and Buddy, Morris Fletcher went with Kid Ren and George, George Washington went with Buddy Petit.

ctx.x: Could they play it like Buddy? Buddy?

Well, see, they didn't have that finger like Buddy, but they could play it though. They could play it like, like, Hippolyte Charles, all of them was good. And his father, he called him, uh, oh, I forgot his name there. Another good time, I can't think of his name.
Who did he play with? Who? This guy whose name you can't think of.
